book.name: Maluku
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Maluku

content: Yecho abhola mabholo gha kutolela na kulekana
Yecho ajhakubhoka pachenda na kujhenda ku Yudeya, ajhakujhomboka kwiye mulukemba lwa ku Yolodane. Lilongo lya bhando lijhakunyendela kabhele, na jwenio ajhakwabhola kabhele ngita chayobhalile.
Bhahe, Mapwalichayo bhange bhajhakunyendelela Yecho kwa kunyambila bhajhakunkonya, “Bho, Lilaghalikilo lya Chapanga lijheketela munalome kuneka nhwana mundo?”
Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Bho, Mucha akanaghalikiye nike?”
Na bhene bhajhakulonge, “Mucha akalaghalikiye munalome anyandikila baluwa na kunneka nhwana gwino.”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Mucha akajhandikile Lilaghalikilo lyenio nhwalo gwa kujhundupa kwa kubholekeka kwino.
Nambo Mucha akajhandike, kuhumii mukupangana nnema Chapanga akapangine munalome na mwikeghe.
‘Peniya, munalome nanneka tate mundo na majhe mundo, nabhabha pamo,
na bhene bhabhele nabhabha yegha jhimo. Na bhabhele kabhejhe, nabhabha yegha jhimo’
Bhahe, chalombaniche Chapanga, abhii jhe mundo jwakulekanicha.”
Pibhajhingila nkate munyumba, bhabholwa bhake bhajhakunkonya nhwalo gwa lilobhe lyenio.
Na Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Mundo jhojhoha jwaneka nhwana mundo na kutolela mwikeghe jhonge, atende ngongola nhwana mundo.
Na helahela mwikeghe jwanneka ungana mundo na kutolelwa na jhonge atende ngongola ungana mundo.”
Yecho aikuchulila yana ichokombe
Bhando bhange bhajhakunete Yecho yana ichokombe aipapahe, bhabholwa bhake bhajhakwipwatalila.
Yecho pabhonita gheniya, ajhakuyoma, ajhakwalobholela, “Muileke yana ihike kwa nenga, mangaibhilikiya, nhwalo Unahota gwa Chapanga ndi kwa bhando bhubhabhii ngita yana.
Ninobholela chakaka, mundo jhojhoha jwangapoke Unahota gwa Chapanga ngita yana ichokombe, nanyingii ng'o mwenio.”
Peniya ajhakwapokela yana yenio, ajhakwabhekela mabhoko, na kuikuchulila kwa Chapanga.
Mundo jwabhii na ilebhe twe

Yecho patumbwila kabhele mwanja gwake, mundo jhumo ajhakunhikilila lubhelo, ajhakutama makilikite palonge jhake, ajhakunkonya, “Mmola jwambone, ndende nike mme na ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta?”
Yecho ajhakunyanguu, “Bho, ungema nenga naumbone? Abhii jhe jwaumbone nga Chapanga kanjika chake.
Mulimanyite maha lilaghalikilo, ‘Nkotoka kutenda ngongola amu nkotoka kukoma amu nkotoka kujhibha amu nkotoka kulonge uwange na nkotoka kukopokeya na bhajhokanikiya tate gwino na majhe gwino.’ ”
Na mundo jwenio ajhakunyanguu, “Mmola, gheniya ghoha nighakamwii punikibha nakangombo.”

Yecho ajhakunnolekeya, ajhakumpala, ajhakunnobholela, “Kipongwike kilebhe chimo. Nnyende mukachuluche ilebhe hino inkwete, mbijha makabhaghulile akahocho, na mwenga namaha na kihukilo kunane. Peniya ndi uhika ungengame.”
Paijhohine gheniya, ajhakuhechuka na kubhoka kongo abhii ngolongondi, nhwalo akibha mundo jhuna ilebhe twe, akapahi jhe kubhoha ilebhe yake.
Yecho ajhakulinga koha, ajhakwalobholela bhabholwa bhake, “Naibhaha kujhundupa kwa mundo jwabhii na ilebhe twe kumpekehe Chapanga anongoche ughome munahota nkolongwa gwake!”
Bhabholwa bhake bhakakangiche malobhe ghake. Yecho ajhakwalobholela kabhele, “Yana yango, chakaka kujhundupa kujhingii mu nahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga!
Ndi ijhojwike kwa kinyama chikikemwa ngamiya kuholota pa lihoto lwa luchungulo lwa mpacha, kuliku jwabhii na ilebhe twe kujhingii mu Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga!”
Bhabholwa bhake bhakakangiche hake bhajha kukonyana, “Ndi ghane bhahe, bho, ghane ngohe nahotola kughombokoka?”
Yecho ajhakwalolekeya, ajhakwalongelela, “Kwa mundo iwechekana jhe, kwa Chapanga naha ndeka, nambo kwa Chapanga ghoha ghiwechekana.”
Peniya Petile ajhakunobholela, “Dolekeya! Na twenga bho? Ghoha tughalekite, tunkengime mwenga!”

Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Ninobholela chakaka, kila mundo jwalekite nyumba, na nnongo mundo na nnombo mundo na majhe mundo na tate mundo na yana mundo na mighonda jhake nhwalo gwa nenga na Malobhe gha Mbone,
napokela mbwe ngoheno. Nyumba na akalongo na nnombo na majhe na yana na mighonda pamonga na malagho, na palonge nabhaha na ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Bhamahena bhibhawacha akanahota bha ngoheno nabhabha akachokombe, bhakujhomolela nabhabhaha bhakutumbula.”
Yecho alonge jha utato kuwe na kuyoka kwake

Bhahe, bhabholwa bhake bhakibha undela kuhobhoka ku Yeluchalemo. Yecho ajhakwalobholela bhabholwa bhake bhakibha na bwaghaliya na bhando bhubhakengima na bhene bhakibha na bwaghaliya helahela. Yecho ajhakwatola bhabholwa panga bhando, ajhakutumbuu kwalongelela ghighapala kunkolela.

Ajhakwalobholela, “Unyokanikiye, tujhenda ku Yeluchalemo, na kwenio Mwana gwa Mundo nabhankamuha kwa akapiya matambiko bhakolo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo. Na bhene nabhahadabulwa bhankome na kunkamuya kwa bhando bha ilambo henge.
Na bhene nabhankinila na kuhunii mata na kunkuna yato na kunkoma. Nambo lichiko lya utato nayoka.”
Yakobu na Yohane bhannyopa kilebhe Yecho
Peniya Yakobu na Yohane, yana mundo Chebedayo, bhajhakunjhendela Yecho, na kunobholela, “Mmola, tupala mututendele kilebhe chitupala kunyopa.”
Yecho ajhakwakonya, “Mipala nintendele nike mangota?”
Bhabholwa bhajhakujhanguu, “Pipala kutama pakigoda chino cha Unahota nkolongwa na ung'alicho gwino, tupala kutama na mwenga, jhumo lubhoko lwalelo na jhonge lubhoko lwa ngejha.”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Umanyite jhe chimujhopa. Bho, mihotola kunywegha mukibaba cha malagho chininywegha nenga, amu kubatichwa ubaticho ngita ghunibatichwa nenga?”
Bhala bhabholwa bhajhakujhanguu, “Tuhotola.” Yecho ajhakwalobhalela, “Komiche jhimbala kunywegha naunywaha kwele, na mbatichwa ubaticho ngita chinibatichwa nenga.
Ndi ghane jwapala kubhehe kwa lelo amu kwa ngejha kwango. Nambo napwache jhango ndeka kupanga, nabhapelwa bhibhapangilwe na Chapanga.”
Bhala bhabholwa bhange kome pibhajhohina chibhajhopita, bhajhakutumbuu kwachimwa Yakobu na Yohane.
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakwakema bhoha na kwalobholela, “Umanye bhala bhibhabhonekana bhakolo kwa bhando bha ilambo henge bhilongocha kwa likakala. Bhakolo bheniya bhina uhotolo ghoha kwa bhando bhabhe.
Nambo kwino mangota nahi jhe, jwapala kubhehe nkolongwa pakate jhino, abhehe ntumiche gwino.
Jwapala kubhehe nkolongwa kupeta bhoha, ipalwa abhaha ntumiche jwabhoha.
Mwana gwa Mundo, ahikitejhe kuhengelwa, nambo ahikite kwahengela, na kubhoha ughome gwake kwakombola bhando bhoha.”
Yecho anamicha jwangalola jwankemitwa Batulumayo

Bhahe, bhakahikite ku Yeliko, na jwenio Yecho na bhabholwa bhake na lilongo lya bhando libhokita kumuche, mundo jhumo jwangalola jwankemitwa Batulomayo mwana gwa Timayo, atamita mupele mwa ndela kujhopajhopa.
Pajhohina Yecho jwa ku Nachalete atehila kupeta peniya, ajhakutumbuu kunonoha lilobhe, “Yecho! Mwana gwa Daude, umonele kiya!”
Bhando bhamahele bhajhakumpwatalila na kunnobholela akotoke, jwenio ajhakuchocha kunonoha lilobhe, “Mwana gwa Daude, umonele kiya!”
Yecho ajhakujhema, kulonge, “Munobholele ahike.” Bhahe, bhajhakunkema jwangalola, bhajhakunobholela, “Nkangamale mwojho! Jhema, ankema.”
Na jwenio ajhakutaghii kutale ngobho yake, ajhakuhomba, ajhakunnyendela Yecho.
Yecho ajhakunkonya, “Mipala nintendele nike?” Jwangalola ajhakunnobholela, “Mmola, nijhopa kulola.”
Yecho ajhakunobholela, “Nnyende, kihobholelo chino kinamiche.” Papalapala jwangalola ajhakulola na kunkengama Yecho.
